## Specification

### Component: Onboarding checklist

A card of setup steps with a progress ring (or bar). Steps tick off with a check that draws itself; the list collapses under the header; finishing the last step celebrates once, subtly. Completed steps are controlled or uncontrolled. A client component.

#### Anatomy
- `<section class="ui-onboarding-checklist" aria-labelledby="<title id>" data-state="open|closed" data-progress="ring|bar" [data-complete] [data-celebrate]>`.
- `.ui-onboarding-checklist-header`:
  - ring layout: `.ui-onboarding-checklist-ring` > `ProgressCircle size="sm"` (40px) showing `<span class="ui-onboarding-checklist-ring-count">2/5</span>`, or when complete `svg.ui-onboarding-checklist-ring-check` (path `M6 12.5l4 4L18 8.5`, `pathLength=1`).
  - `.ui-onboarding-checklist-heading` > `h3.ui-onboarding-checklist-title` + `p.ui-onboarding-checklist-description`.
  - complete + `onDismiss`: ghost sm `Button.ui-onboarding-checklist-dismiss`.
  - collapsible: `button.ui-onboarding-checklist-toggle` (`aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` = list, `aria-labelledby` = title) > chevron-down `.ui-onboarding-checklist-chevron`.
- bar layout: `.ui-onboarding-checklist-bar` > `Progress size="sm"` + `.ui-onboarding-checklist-count` ("2/5", aria-hidden).
- `Collapse.ui-onboarding-checklist-body` (shared with Accordion: grid row 0fr ↔ 1fr, `hidden="until-found"` when closed) > `ol.ui-onboarding-checklist-steps`.
- Step `li.ui-onboarding-checklist-step[data-state="complete|incomplete"][data-current][data-disabled]`:
  - `.ui-onboarding-checklist-check` > `input[type=checkbox].ui-onboarding-checklist-input` (invisible, covers the indicator, 8px larger) + `.ui-onboarding-checklist-indicator` (aria-hidden; svg path `M4 8.5l2.5 2.5L12 5.5`, `pathLength=1`).
  - `.ui-onboarding-checklist-step-body` > `label.ui-onboarding-checklist-step-title` (for the input) + `.ui-onboarding-checklist-step-description`.
  - `.ui-onboarding-checklist-step-action` while not done.
- `span.ui-onboarding-checklist-sr[role=status]` announces "All steps complete".

#### Props
- `title`, `description`, `steps: { id, title, description?, action?, disabled?, checkable? }[]`.
- `value` / `defaultValue` / `onValueChange` (completed ids, kept in step order); `onComplete` (once, on becoming complete, never on mount).
- `checkable` (true; `false` = the app marks steps done, indicators only, done steps get an sr-only "(Completed)").
- `collapsible` (true), `open` / `defaultOpen` (true) / `onOpenChange`.
- `progress`: `ring` (default) | `bar`. `completeTitle`, `completeDescription`, `onDismiss`, `headingLevel` (3), `labels` (`progress`, `count(done,total)`, `allComplete`, `completed`, `dismiss`).

#### Behaviour
- Current step = first step not done and not disabled → `data-current` (soft highlight).
- Progress: `value=done`, `max=total`, `aria-valuetext` "2 of 5 steps complete", tone `success` when complete.
- Celebration state is derived during render when `complete` flips to true; `data-celebrate` stays 1200ms. Un-ticking a step returns to the normal state.

#### Visual rules
- Card: 1px `--ui-border`, `--radius-xl`, `--ui-surface`, no shadow. Header padding 16px 12px 16px 20px, gap 14px. Title 15px/600 −0.01em; description 13px muted.
- Toggle 32px square, radius md, muted; hover `--ui-accent`. Chevron rotates 180° when open (snappy spring).
- List: padding 8px, top border `--ui-border-subtle`, 2px gap. Step: grid `20px 1fr auto`, gap 12px, padding 10px 12px, radius = card radius − 8px. Current: foreground 4% wash.
- Indicator: 20px circle, 1.5px `--ui-border-strong`; done: `--ui-control-on` disc, `--ui-control-glyph` check 14px stroke 2. Hover (fine pointer): border `--ui-ring`.
- Done title: muted colour, line-through in muted 70% (always present, transparent when not done, so it fades).
- ≤ 480px: action wraps under the text.

#### Motion
- Tick: disc `scale(0 → 1)` on `--ui-spring-morph`, check `stroke-dashoffset 1 → 0` 320ms `--ui-ease-out` after 90ms. Un-tick reverses faster (`--ui-duration-fast`, ease-in). Transitions, so nothing replays on mount. Press: indicator `scale(.92)`.
- Finish (once): ring pops 1 → 1.08 → 1 (520ms), a success halo spreads 0 → 14px and fades (900ms, 120ms delay), the ring check draws (360ms, 160ms delay), title and description rise 6px with a 2px blur (380ms, stagger 35ms).
- Collapse: Accordion's grid-row animation (smooth spring open, 260ms close).
- Reduced motion: every celebration animation off; states change instantly.

#### Accessibility
- `<section>` named by the title; steps are an ordered list. Each checkable step is a native checkbox labelled by its title (clicking the title toggles it) and described by its description.
- Collapse button: disclosure pattern (`aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`), named by the title.
- Completion is announced through a polite `role="status"` region.

#### Acceptance checks
- Ticking a step updates `aria-valuenow` and the "n/total" count; the check draws; the title fades to muted with a strike.
- Ticking the last step sets `data-complete`, swaps the title to `completeTitle`, turns the ring success, announces "All steps complete" and calls `onComplete` once.
- The toggle collapses the list (hidden after the animation) and `aria-expanded` follows.
- Controlled `value` drives the steps; uncontrolled `defaultValue` seeds them.

### `ui/components/onboarding-checklist/onboarding-checklist-item.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import type { OnboardingChecklistStep } from './onboarding-checklist';

interface OnboardingChecklistItemProps {
  baseId: string;
  step: OnboardingChecklistStep;
  done: boolean;
  /** The first step that is not done (gets a soft highlight). */
  current: boolean;
  checkable: boolean;
  completedLabel: string;
  onToggle: (id: string, checked: boolean) => void;
}

/** Ids must stay valid for aria-labelledby whatever the step id looks like. */
const slug = (value: string) => value.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_');

/**
 * One step row: a round check (a native checkbox when checkable), the title
 * and description, and the step's action while it is not done. Internal.
 */
export function OnboardingChecklistItem({
  baseId,
  step,
  done,
  current,
  checkable,
  completedLabel,
  onToggle,
}: OnboardingChecklistItemProps) {
  const titleId = `${baseId}-step-${slug(step.id)}`;
  const descId = `${titleId}-desc`;
  const inputId = `${titleId}-input`;
  const hasDescription = step.description != null && step.description !== false;

  const indicator = (
    <span className="ui-onboarding-checklist-indicator" aria-hidden="true">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" focusable="false">
        <path d="M4 8.5l2.5 2.5L12 5.5" pathLength={1} />
      </svg>
    </span>
  );

  return (
    <li
      className="ui-onboarding-checklist-step"
      data-state={done ? 'complete' : 'incomplete'}
      data-current={current ? '' : undefined}
      data-disabled={step.disabled ? '' : undefined}
    >
      <span className="ui-onboarding-checklist-check">
        {checkable ? (
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            id={inputId}
            className="ui-onboarding-checklist-input"
            checked={done}
            disabled={step.disabled}
            aria-labelledby={titleId}
            aria-describedby={hasDescription ? descId : undefined}
            onChange={(e) => onToggle(step.id, e.currentTarget.checked)}
          />
        ) : null}
        {indicator}
      </span>

      <div className="ui-onboarding-checklist-step-body">
        {checkable ? (
          // The title is the checkbox's <label>, so clicking it toggles the step too
          <label id={titleId} htmlFor={inputId} className="ui-onboarding-checklist-step-title">
            {step.title}
          </label>
        ) : (
          <span id={titleId} className="ui-onboarding-checklist-step-title">
            {step.title}
            {done && <span className="ui-onboarding-checklist-sr"> ({completedLabel})</span>}
          </span>
        )}
        {hasDescription && (
          <span id={descId} className="ui-onboarding-checklist-step-description">
            {step.description}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {!done && step.action != null && <div className="ui-onboarding-checklist-step-action">{step.action}</div>}
    </li>
  );
}
```

### `ui/components/onboarding-checklist/onboarding-checklist.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type HTMLAttributes, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { Collapse } from '../accordion/collapse';
import { Button } from '../button/button';
import { Progress, ProgressCircle } from '../progress/progress';
import { OnboardingChecklistItem } from './onboarding-checklist-item';

export interface OnboardingChecklistStep {
  /** Stable id; completed steps are tracked by id. */
  id: string;
  title: ReactNode;
  /** One line on why or how. */
  description?: ReactNode;
  /** Shown while the step is not done, e.g. a small button or link that starts it. */
  action?: ReactNode;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Override the checklist's `checkable` for this step. */
  checkable?: boolean;
}

export interface OnboardingChecklistLabels {
  /** Name of the progress indicator. Default `Setup progress`. */
  progress?: string;
  /** Announced and shown in the bar layout. Default `{done} of {total} steps complete`. */
  count?: (done: number, total: number) => string;
  /** Announced when the last step is ticked. Default `All steps complete`. */
  allComplete?: string;
  /** Screen-reader suffix on a done step that has no checkbox. Default `Completed`. */
  completed?: string;
  /** Dismiss button in the finished state. Default `Dismiss`. */
  dismiss?: string;
}

export interface OnboardingChecklistProps
  extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, 'title' | 'defaultValue' | 'onChange'> {
  title: ReactNode;
  description?: ReactNode;
  /** The steps, in order. */
  steps: OnboardingChecklistStep[];
  /** Controlled: ids of the completed steps. */
  value?: string[];
  /** Initial completed ids when uncontrolled. */
  defaultValue?: string[];
  /** Called with the new list of completed ids. */
  onValueChange?: (value: string[]) => void;
  /** Called once when the last step is completed (not on mount). */
  onComplete?: () => void;
  /** Steps can be ticked by the user. `false` when the app marks them done. Default true. */
  checkable?: boolean;
  /** The header gets a button that hides the steps. Default true. */
  collapsible?: boolean;
  /** Controlled: steps visible. */
  open?: boolean;
  /** Initial visibility when uncontrolled. Default true. */
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  /** Progress as a 40px `ring` beside the title or a `bar` under it. Default `ring`. */
  progress?: 'ring' | 'bar';
  /** Title once every step is done. Default: `title`. */
  completeTitle?: ReactNode;
  /** Description once every step is done. Default: `description`. */
  completeDescription?: ReactNode;
  /** Shows a Dismiss button in the finished state. */
  onDismiss?: () => void;
  /** Heading level of the title. Default 3. */
  headingLevel?: 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6;
  labels?: OnboardingChecklistLabels;
}

const DEFAULT_LABELS: Required<OnboardingChecklistLabels> = {
  progress: 'Setup progress',
  count: (done, total) => `${done} of ${total} steps complete`,
  allComplete: 'All steps complete',
  completed: 'Completed',
  dismiss: 'Dismiss',
};

/** How long the finish celebration keeps its data attribute (longest animation + margin). */
const CELEBRATE_MS = 1200;

/**
 * OnboardingChecklist — a card of setup steps with a progress ring or bar.
 * Steps tick off with a check that draws itself; the list collapses under the
 * header; finishing the last step celebrates once (ring pop, halo, check).
 * Completed steps are controlled (`value`) or uncontrolled (`defaultValue`).
 */
export const OnboardingChecklist = forwardRef<HTMLElement, OnboardingChecklistProps>(function OnboardingChecklist(
  {
    title,
    description,
    steps,
    value: valueProp,
    defaultValue = [],
    onValueChange,
    onComplete,
    checkable = true,
    collapsible = true,
    open: openProp,
    defaultOpen = true,
    onOpenChange,
    progress = 'ring',
    completeTitle,
    completeDescription,
    onDismiss,
    headingLevel = 3,
    labels: labelsProp,
    className,
    ...props
  },
  ref,
) {
  const labels = { ...DEFAULT_LABELS, ...labelsProp };
  const [value, setValue] = useControllableState<string[]>({ value: valueProp, defaultValue, onChange: onValueChange });
  const [open, setOpen] = useControllableState({ value: openProp, defaultValue: defaultOpen, onChange: onOpenChange });
  const id = useId();
  const titleId = `${id}-title`;
  const listId = `${id}-steps`;

  const doneSet = new Set(value);
  const total = steps.length;
  const done = steps.filter((s) => doneSet.has(s.id)).length;
  const complete = total > 0 && done === total;
  const currentId = steps.find((s) => !doneSet.has(s.id) && !s.disabled)?.id;

  // Celebrate only when the checklist *becomes* complete, never on mount
  const [prevComplete, setPrevComplete] = useState(complete);
  const [celebrating, setCelebrating] = useState(false);
  const [announced, setAnnounced] = useState(false);
  if (complete !== prevComplete) {
    setPrevComplete(complete);
    setCelebrating(complete);
    setAnnounced(complete);
  }
  const onCompleteRef = useRef(onComplete);
  onCompleteRef.current = onComplete;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!celebrating) return;
    onCompleteRef.current?.();
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => setCelebrating(false), CELEBRATE_MS);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
  }, [celebrating]);

  const toggleStep = (stepId: string, checked: boolean) =>
    setValue((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (checked) next.add(stepId);
      else next.delete(stepId);
      // Keep the steps' order so the value is stable
      return steps.map((s) => s.id).filter((sid) => next.has(sid));
    });

  const Heading = `h${headingLevel}` as 'h3';
  const countText = labels.count(done, total);
  const shownTitle = complete && completeTitle != null ? completeTitle : title;
  const shownDescription = complete && completeDescription != null ? completeDescription : description;

  return (
    <section
      ref={ref}
      aria-labelledby={titleId}
      data-state={open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
      data-complete={complete ? '' : undefined}
      data-celebrate={celebrating ? '' : undefined}
      data-progress={progress}
      className={cn('ui-onboarding-checklist', className)}
      {...props}
    >
      <div className="ui-onboarding-checklist-header">
        {progress === 'ring' && (
          <span className="ui-onboarding-checklist-ring">
            <ProgressCircle
              size="sm"
              value={done}
              max={Math.max(total, 1)}
              tone={complete ? 'success' : 'default'}
              aria-label={labels.progress}
              getValueText={() => countText}
            >
              {complete ? (
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" className="ui-onboarding-checklist-ring-check" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
                  <path d="M6 12.5l4 4L18 8.5" pathLength={1} />
                </svg>
              ) : (
                <span className="ui-onboarding-checklist-ring-count">
                  {done}/{total}
                </span>
              )}
            </ProgressCircle>
          </span>
        )}

        <div className="ui-onboarding-checklist-heading">
          <Heading id={titleId} className="ui-onboarding-checklist-title" key={complete ? 'done' : 'todo'}>
            {shownTitle}
          </Heading>
          {shownDescription != null && <p className="ui-onboarding-checklist-description">{shownDescription}</p>}
        </div>

        {complete && onDismiss && (
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="ui-onboarding-checklist-dismiss" onClick={onDismiss}>
            {labels.dismiss}
          </Button>
        )}
        {collapsible && (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="ui-onboarding-checklist-toggle"
            aria-expanded={open}
            aria-controls={listId}
            aria-labelledby={titleId}
            onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
          >
            <Icon name="chevron-down" size={16} className="ui-onboarding-checklist-chevron" />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {progress === 'bar' && (
        <div className="ui-onboarding-checklist-bar">
          <Progress
            size="sm"
            value={done}
            max={Math.max(total, 1)}
            tone={complete ? 'success' : 'default'}
            aria-label={labels.progress}
            getValueText={() => countText}
          />
          <span className="ui-onboarding-checklist-count" aria-hidden="true">
            {done}/{total}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      <Collapse
        id={listId}
        open={!collapsible || open}
        onReveal={() => setOpen(true)}
        className="ui-onboarding-checklist-body"
      >
        <ol className="ui-onboarding-checklist-steps">
          {steps.map((step) => (
            <OnboardingChecklistItem
              key={step.id}
              baseId={id}
              step={step}
              done={doneSet.has(step.id)}
              current={step.id === currentId}
              checkable={step.checkable ?? checkable}
              completedLabel={labels.completed}
              onToggle={toggleStep}
            />
          ))}
        </ol>
      </Collapse>

      <span role="status" className="ui-onboarding-checklist-sr">
        {announced ? labels.allComplete : ''}
      </span>
    </section>
  );
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/onboarding-checklist.css`

```css
/* Onboarding checklist -----------------------------------------------------
   <section class="ui-onboarding-checklist" data-state="open|closed" data-progress="ring|bar"
            [data-complete] [data-celebrate] aria-labelledby="…title">
     .ui-onboarding-checklist-header
       .ui-onboarding-checklist-ring > .ui-progress-circle.ui-progress-circle-sm
           (> -ring-count "2/5" | svg.ui-onboarding-checklist-ring-check)
       .ui-onboarding-checklist-heading > h3.-title + p.-description
       [.ui-btn.ui-onboarding-checklist-dismiss]  button.ui-onboarding-checklist-toggle > .-chevron
     [.ui-onboarding-checklist-bar > .ui-progress.ui-progress-sm + .-count]
     .ui-collapse.ui-onboarding-checklist-body > .ui-collapse-inner > ol.ui-onboarding-checklist-steps
       li.ui-onboarding-checklist-step[data-state="complete|incomplete"][data-current][data-disabled]
         .-check > input.-input[type=checkbox] + .-indicator > svg path
         .-step-body > label.-step-title + .-step-description
         .-step-action
     span.ui-onboarding-checklist-sr[role=status]
   Ticking a step: the disc grows on the morph spring, the check draws (transitions,
   so nothing replays on mount). Finishing: ring pops, a halo spreads, the check in
   the ring draws, the title rises in — once, while [data-celebrate] is set.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@keyframes ui-onboarding-checklist-pop {
  0% { transform: scale(1); }
  35% { transform: scale(1.08); }
  100% { transform: scale(1); }
}
@keyframes ui-onboarding-checklist-halo {
  from { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-success) 40%, transparent); }
  to { box-shadow: 0 0 0 14px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-success) 0%, transparent); }
}
@keyframes ui-onboarding-checklist-draw {
  from { stroke-dashoffset: 1; }
  to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
}
@keyframes ui-onboarding-checklist-rise {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); filter: blur(var(--ui-blur-subtle)); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: none; filter: none; }
}

@layer components {
  .ui-onboarding-checklist {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    background-color: var(--ui-surface);
    color: var(--ui-surface-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    line-height: var(--text-base--line-height);
  }

  /* Header */
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.875rem;
    padding: 1rem 0.75rem 1rem 1.25rem;
  }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-ring { position: relative; display: inline-grid; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 9999px; }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-ring::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; pointer-events: none; }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-ring-count { font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-ring-check {
    display: block;
    width: 1.125rem;
    height: 1.125rem;
    fill: none;
    stroke: var(--ui-success-text);
    stroke-width: 2.5;
    stroke-linecap: round;
    stroke-linejoin: round;
    stroke-dasharray: 1;
    stroke-dashoffset: 0;
  }

  .ui-onboarding-checklist-heading { display: grid; flex: 1 1 auto; gap: 0.125rem; min-width: 0; }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-title {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: var(--text-md);
    line-height: var(--text-md--line-height);
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    color: var(--ui-surface-foreground);
  }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-description {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
    line-height: var(--text-sm--line-height);
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
  }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-dismiss { flex-shrink: 0; }

  .ui-onboarding-checklist-toggle {
    display: grid;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    place-items: center;
    width: 2rem;
    height: 2rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    cursor: pointer;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    outline: none;
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-onboarding-checklist-toggle:hover { background-color: var(--ui-accent); color: var(--ui-accent-foreground); }
  }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-toggle:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-chevron { transition: transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy); }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .ui-onboarding-checklist-chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); }

  /* Bar layout */
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    padding: 0 1.25rem 1rem;
    margin-top: -0.25rem;
  }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-count {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    line-height: var(--text-xs--line-height);
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }

  /* Steps */
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-steps {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.125rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0.5rem;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--ui-border-subtle);
    list-style: none;
  }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-step {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.25rem minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    align-items: start;
    column-gap: 0.75rem;
    padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem;
    /* Concentric with the card: outer radius minus the list padding */
    border-radius: max(4px, calc(var(--radius-xl) - 0.5rem));
    transition: background-color var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-step[data-current] { background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 4%, transparent); }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-step[data-disabled] { opacity: 0.5; }

  /* The round check: native checkbox on top (invisible), drawn indicator under it */
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-check {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    width: 1.25rem;
    height: 1.25rem;
    margin-top: 0.0625rem;
  }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-input {
    position: absolute;
    inset: -0.375rem;
    z-index: 1;
    width: auto;
    height: auto;
    margin: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-indicator {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 1.25rem;
    height: 1.25rem;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--ui-border-strong);
    border-radius: 9999px;
    color: var(--ui-control-glyph);
    transition:
      border-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-indicator::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: -1.5px;
    border-radius: inherit;
    background-color: var(--ui-control-on);
    transform: scale(0);
    transition: transform var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-in);
  }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-indicator > svg {
    position: relative;
    width: 0.875rem;
    height: 0.875rem;
    fill: none;
    stroke: currentColor;
    stroke-width: 2;
    stroke-linecap: round;
    stroke-linejoin: round;
    stroke-dasharray: 1;
    stroke-dashoffset: 1;
    transition: stroke-dashoffset var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-in);
  }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-step[data-state="complete"] .ui-onboarding-checklist-indicator { border-color: var(--ui-control-on); }
  /* Ticking: the disc grows on the morph spring, then the check draws */
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-step[data-state="complete"] .ui-onboarding-checklist-indicator::before {
    transform: scale(1);
    transition: transform var(--ui-spring-morph-duration) var(--ui-spring-morph);
  }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-step[data-state="complete"] .ui-onboarding-checklist-indicator > svg {
    stroke-dashoffset: 0;
    transition: stroke-dashoffset 320ms var(--ui-ease-out) 90ms;
  }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-onboarding-checklist-check:hover .ui-onboarding-checklist-input:not(:disabled) + .ui-onboarding-checklist-indicator { border-color: var(--ui-ring); }
    .ui-onboarding-checklist-step[data-state="complete"] .ui-onboarding-checklist-check:hover .ui-onboarding-checklist-indicator { border-color: var(--ui-control-on); }
  }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-input:focus-visible + .ui-onboarding-checklist-indicator {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-input:active:not(:disabled) + .ui-onboarding-checklist-indicator { transform: scale(0.92); }

  .ui-onboarding-checklist-step-body { display: grid; gap: 0.125rem; min-width: 0; }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-step-title {
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--ui-surface-foreground);
    text-decoration: line-through;
    text-decoration-color: transparent;
    text-decoration-thickness: 1px;
    transition:
      color var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      text-decoration-color var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  label.ui-onboarding-checklist-step-title { cursor: pointer; }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-step[data-disabled] label.ui-onboarding-checklist-step-title { cursor: not-allowed; }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-step[data-state="complete"] .ui-onboarding-checklist-step-title {
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    text-decoration-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-muted-foreground) 70%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-step-description {
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
    line-height: var(--text-sm--line-height);
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
  }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-step-action {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    align-self: center;
  }

  /* Phones: the action drops under the text */
  @media (max-width: 30rem) {
    .ui-onboarding-checklist-step { grid-template-columns: 1.25rem minmax(0, 1fr); }
    .ui-onboarding-checklist-step-action { grid-column: 2; justify-self: start; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
  }

  /* Finished: one celebration while [data-celebrate] is set */
  .ui-onboarding-checklist[data-celebrate] .ui-onboarding-checklist-ring {
    animation: ui-onboarding-checklist-pop 520ms var(--ui-ease-out) both;
  }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist[data-celebrate] .ui-onboarding-checklist-ring::after {
    animation: ui-onboarding-checklist-halo 900ms var(--ui-ease-out) 120ms both;
  }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist[data-celebrate] .ui-onboarding-checklist-ring-check {
    animation: ui-onboarding-checklist-draw 360ms var(--ui-ease-out) 160ms both;
  }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist[data-celebrate] .ui-onboarding-checklist-title,
  .ui-onboarding-checklist[data-celebrate] .ui-onboarding-checklist-description {
    animation: ui-onboarding-checklist-rise var(--ui-duration-slow) var(--ui-ease-out) both;
  }
  .ui-onboarding-checklist[data-celebrate] .ui-onboarding-checklist-description { animation-delay: var(--ui-stagger); }

  /* Screen-reader only (live region, "Completed" suffix) */
  .ui-onboarding-checklist-sr {
    position: absolute;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    margin: -1px;
    padding: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip-path: inset(50%);
    white-space: nowrap;
    border: 0;
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .ui-onboarding-checklist[data-celebrate] .ui-onboarding-checklist-ring,
    .ui-onboarding-checklist[data-celebrate] .ui-onboarding-checklist-ring::after,
    .ui-onboarding-checklist[data-celebrate] .ui-onboarding-checklist-ring-check,
    .ui-onboarding-checklist[data-celebrate] .ui-onboarding-checklist-title,
    .ui-onboarding-checklist[data-celebrate] .ui-onboarding-checklist-description { animation: none; }
  }
}
```

## Usage

**Checklist** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/onboarding-checklist/workspace.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { OnboardingChecklist } from '@/ui/components/onboarding-checklist';

export default function OnboardingChecklistWorkspace() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-lg">
      <OnboardingChecklist
        title="Set up your workspace"
        description="Five steps to your first deploy."
        completeTitle="Your workspace is ready"
        completeDescription="Everything is set up. Happy shipping."
        defaultValue={['workspace']}
        steps={[
          { id: 'workspace', title: 'Create your workspace', description: 'Name it and pick a region.' },
          {
            id: 'team',
            title: 'Invite your team',
            description: 'Teammates get access to every project.',
            action: <Button size="xs" variant="outline">Invite</Button>,
          },
          { id: 'repo', title: 'Connect a repository', description: 'GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket.' },
          { id: 'billing', title: 'Add a payment method', description: 'You won’t be charged during the trial.' },
          { id: 'deploy', title: 'Deploy your first project' },
        ]}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```
